people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”
translations.bsb: And that night God spoke to Israel in a vision: “Jacob, Jacob!” He said. “Here I am,” replied Jacob.
